boundary: a recovery preserves rather than erases the failed witness and does not convert it into canonical or completion credit

failures.failure: the initial large activation-baton display exceeded the visible output window
failures.recovery: read the committed baton through EOF in bounded windows and verify its exact digest

failures.failure: an aggregated three-window baton recovery was itself truncated
failures.recovery: use smaller sequential windows with explicit ending-line evidence

failures.failure: a PowerShell direct foreach skill-inventory projection produced an empty-pipe ParserError
failures.recovery: use bounded arrays and scalar projections

failures.failure: a combined source-equality projection had a missing-closing-parenthesis ParserError
failures.recovery: use separate literal scalar ancestry and equality probes

failures.failure: the corrected combined source probe produced no attributable output
failures.recovery: split exact head, parent, divergence, and live-remote checks

failures.failure: an oversized proposal-freeze display exceeded the bounded result window
failures.recovery: project only required schema keys and exact counts

failures.failure: a direct foreach manifest projection produced another empty-pipe ParserError
failures.recovery: use a bounded manifest replay loop with explicit accumulators

failures.failure: a combined CLI registry and storage probe returned only the first CLI field
failures.recovery: query version, registry, and storage as separate scalar dependencies

failures.failure: an isolated registry-version projection returned no output
failures.recovery: use the exact package metadata query and retain the verified 0.149.0 equality

failures.failure: an old-template byte-conversion PowerShell projection failed
failures.recovery: inspect bounded text windows directly without byte-array conversion

failures.failure: an exact toolchain extraction omitted its path variable and accidentally launched a broad read-only search across the control directory
failures.recovery: discard the truncated output and require a resolved literal file before every future search

failures.failure: a combined sparse materialization and status summary returned no attributable output
failures.recovery: separate sparse-pattern, head, diff, and untracked scalars

failures.failure: a split sparse-status probe stalled after printing only the patterns
failures.recovery: avoid broad status and use exact diff-index and owner-path probes

failures.failure: a thirty-second process-poll wrapper yielded without an output payload
failures.recovery: inspect exact process names and repository locks before any retry

failures.failure: an oversized x2-builder read exceeded the model context window
failures.recovery: read only targeted definitions and bounded line windows

failures.failure: the sparse read-tree materialization crossed its yield and returned no live handle while continuing

failures.failure: a duplicate read-tree attempt was refused by the still-active index lock
failures.recovery: treat the lock as active-state evidence and do not remove or override it

failures.failure: the first process diagnostic matched its own PowerShell command text instead of the Git process
